title: Electrical Power — Generator Control Unit — Install the Uprated Splice Module and Load the Ground Inhibit Configuration
abstract: Retrofit of the second issue generator control unit standard: install the uprated splice module in the distribution bay and load the configuration that inhibits the thermal shed on the ground with a door open.

sections.planning_reason: The first issue reduced ground channel losses but did not remove them, and the larger variant was never covered. Twenty-six further events were recorded across eleven operators in two summers, six of them on aircraft already carrying the first issue. The second issue adds a ground inhibit and raises the threshold on the higher rated installation, and requires a splice module change to carry the maintenance status line that replaces the flight deck caution.
sections.description: This bulletin replaces the splice module in the distribution bay with the uprated item, adds the status line to the existing harness using the supplied contacts, and loads the second issue configuration into both generator control units. The relay assembly and the sensing pair identification introduced by the first issue are retained unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the distribution bay, isolate both channels and put the warning notices in position. Disconnect and remove the existing splice module, install the uprated module on the existing mounting holes and torque as specified. Fit the two supplied contacts into the free positions of the existing connector and route the status line along the existing loom, retained by the supplied cable ties. Load the second issue configuration into both control units with the portable loader and confirm the reported part number. Do the functional test of the generator control channel in AMM-M-24-20-12-700-032-A and confirm the ground inhibit behaves as described with a door open. Update the parts catalogue effectivity record and close the bay.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to all MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft delivered before MSN M00370. The larger variant was added to the retrofit population while this Service Bulletin was being prepared and is covered by the same accomplishment; the splice module and the configuration are common to both variants.
sections.material_note: Kit contains the uprated splice module, two connector contacts, cable ties and the bay label set. The removed splice module is returned under the warranty scheme.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 36 months of the date of this Service Bulletin, or at the next scheduled base maintenance visit, whichever occurs first.

This condition was written for the original MERIDIAN-42 population and was not restated when the larger variant was brought into the effectivity; it applies to the larger variant in exactly the same way, and no MERIDIAN-46 is eligible for this Service Bulletin without the first issue standard either. Check the aircraft configuration record for the first issue before the kit is ordered, whichever variant it is.

Revision two restates the first issue standard as a condition of the effectivity for both variants and corrects the torque figure quoted for the module mounting.
